summary.text:
Prevent Homelessness Act of 2025
This bill establishes the Housing Stabilization Fund to provide annual grants for nonprofit organizations and state and local governments that assist homeless individuals and families through the Continuum of Care Program.
Grants must be used to provide emergency housing assistance (e.g., rental, mortgage, or utility payments or repairs necessary to make the premises habitable) for extremely low-income families and very low-income families.
